title: Genie One enhancements
body:
* **Scheduled task consistency**: Scheduled tasks now look up past runs to keep run-to-run outputs consistent. See [Scheduled tasks](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#scheduled-tasks).
* **Export documents to PDF**: You can now export Genie One documents to PDF. See [Documents in Genie One](/aws/en/genie-one/documents).
* **Genie mobile (Public Preview)**: Enhancements to the Genie mobile app:
  + **Switch workspaces without signing out**: You can now switch between workspaces from within the app instead of signing out and back in. See [Switch workspaces](/aws/en/genie-one/mobile#switch-workspaces).
  + **Sign in behind account-level IP access lists**: If you were blocked at mobile sign-in by an account-level IP access list, you can now sign in. If your workspace is restricted to your corporate network, off-network devices still need to reach it through that network, such as with a VPN or a managed device.
